summary: Facepalm: I'm submitting two facepalm candidates for 2026-09-27. Both are government billing or election-mailing errors from September 21–23, and each is checked against pages I opened. (1) San Diego's trash-fee error on about 87,000 property tax bills (CA), sourced to KPBS and NBC San Diego. Last run it was set aside only because the summary ran past three sentences; I've rewritten it as two. (2) Montgomery County, MD voter guides that listed the wrong polling place and party for 11 precincts. Last run it was set aside because the county .gov statement looked like it was from 2024. I opened it this time and it is dated Wednesday, September 23, 2026, so it can be the official source alongside foxbaltimore.com. All four quote and corroboration passages match the opened pages exactly. I ran out of search calls partway through, so there are only two candidates and no further alternates. Genius: Scan for 2026-09-27 (window 2026-09-21 to 09-27), genius side. Partway through, the search and fetch tools hit their usage limit, so most leads could not be backed by a second source. One candidate is fully sourced: the Purdue-led Perseverance study of the Margin Unit, published September 21 and confirmed by Space.com (Sept 24) and NASA JPL (Sept 21). A Sept 26 run set it aside only because the entry was malformed. Its facts and dates are now confirmed and the entry is correctly formed. Several other leads were set aside for lack of a second accepted source, a non-US lead, or dates outside the window. Pair published.
